# NYC know before you go
Date: 2026-10-09 | Duration: 11.720000267028809m

## Summary
The team finalized preparations for an event by confirming pre-event and day-of-event emails, attendee updates, printing responsibilities, transportation, supply delivery, and contingency plans. Lyndsie Berens would arrive early with name tags and notebooks, while Cary Rakin coordinated transport and material handoffs. The event had 14 attendees from 10 companies, including strategic prospects from Amex and A24 Films, while Expedia was nearing a verbal commitment. Ashley Stirrup took over Scott’s accounts, including Disney and The New York Times, and Cary offered support for Fiserv and A24 Films. Customer-specific talking points included TaskRabbit’s work on interleaving and switchbacks, Disney’s vacation-related interests, Boston Globe’s recent conversion, and Expedia’s travel-industry potential. The team also aligned 35 notebooks with 39 expected attendees, planned to use onsite reserves if needed, and would return unused supplies to Snowflake.

## Keywords
RSVPs, Event logistics, Tindy profiles, Account management, Pre-event communication, Customer engagement

## Action Items

Send out all event-related links to the team via the dinner channel (06:12)
Bring prints, name tags, and other supplies for the event, and coordinate supply storage/shipment post-event (07:48)

**Ashley Stirrup**
Take over Scott’s table accounts including Disney and New York Times and prepare accordingly (06:24)
Review and potentially bring additional notebooks from own stock if needed for the event (09:31)
